plans.feedback: Sua bug da tai hien trong search hien co: title "ĐI CHỢ" nhung q="đi chợ" tra [] vi SQLite lower chi ASCII. Giu tat ca CRUD/Web error/retry/stale/double-submit da delivery. Them focused pytest that fails truocfix cho ĐI CHỢ vs đi chợ va Straße vs STRASSE, giu literal wildcard/status AND. Fix chi vai dong backend; khong sua HTML, khong cai lai venv/deps, khong baseline rediscovery. Use explicit cd application cwd and .venv/bin/python -m pytest; .venv is ready. One batch exec to add red test, capture red, edit lines, capture green. No browser/UAT. Existing actual checks PASS except this demonstrated Unicode bug.
